Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan provides a comprehensive district-wide inventory including building age, size, classroom counts, and detailed site maps for all schools (Sections 3, pages 21-42). It includes a robust condition assessment covering major systems (HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, accessibility) with detailed cost estimates and priority rankings (Sections 3, pages 23-52). The plan connects condition data to instructional priorities and long-term capital planning.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: The plan includes historic enrollment data and some discussion of enrollment trends (Executive Summary, pages 4-5), but lacks detailed long-term enrollment projections or capacity utilization data by site or classroom. There is limited connection of enrollment trends to specific facility actions or adaptive space use strategies.

Educational Alignment.justification: The plan references educational goals and programs such as CTE, preschool, and special education buildings (Executive Summary, pages 6-7; High School assessment, page 40), but does not provide detailed educational specifications or explicitly connect facility projects to instructional needs or program requirements.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: The plan mentions outdoor facilities such as sports fields, playgrounds, and irrigation system upgrades (Elementary and High School assessments, pages 24, 43), but provides minimal detail or analysis of green space, shade coverage, or greening strategies. There is no districtwide data or comprehensive greening strategy.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: There is no mention of climate risk assessment, climate impacts, or climate resilience strategies in the plan. Emergency preparedness is not linked to climate change.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: The plan references some energy efficiency upgrades such as LED lighting and HVAC replacements (Elementary and High School assessments, pages 24, 45), but lacks comprehensive energy use data, resilience strategies, or references to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan presents a detailed financial strategy including cost estimates for modernization and new construction projects, funding sources such as state modernization, new construction funding, developer fees, bonds, and certificates of participation (Sections 2 and 3, pages 6-17). It includes prioritization guidance and aligns funding strategies with district needs.
